name: enb
description: Multivariate regression data set from: https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007%2Fs10994-016-5546-z : The Energy Building dataset (Tsanas and Xifara 2012) concerns the prediction of the heating load and cooling load requirements of buildings (i.e. energy efficiency) as a function of eight building parameters such as glazing area, roof area, and overall height, amongst others.
